answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the copper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the haven of the next round. Reaching the violet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on invitation quota tree, converted to a slow vesting stream.
